domains.name: Recent Symptoms
domains.summary: Symptoms experienced within the last 72 hours, including psychiatric symptoms, slurred speech, and vomiting.

domains.name: Athletic Status
domains.summary: Whether the child was an athlete, participation in competitive sports six months prior, and type of sport.

domains.name: Blood Relative Health Conditions
domains.summary: Health conditions present among blood relatives including aortic aneurysm, arrhythmia, cardiomyopathy, congenital heart disease, connective tissue disease, and others.

domains.name: Cardiac Treatments
domains.summary: Types of cardiac treatments received such as ablation, catheterization, device placement, surgery, transplant, or none.

domains.name: Diagnoses
domains.summary: Various diagnoses including aneurysm, arrhythmia, asthma, brain hemorrhage, cardiomyopathy, congenital disorders, connective tissue disease, and others.

domains.name: Case Classification
domains.summary: Whether the case is a gatekeeper case or if the death was due to homicide, suicide, overdose, or injury.

domains.name: Physical Activity Symptoms
domains.summary: Symptoms experienced during physical activity such as shortness of breath, chest pain, confusion, convulsions, dizziness, fainting, headache, palpitations, and others.

domains.name: Previous Injuries
domains.summary: Information on previous serious injuries including whether they occurred and details of the injury if applicable.
